headerDisplay: See the [README](https://github.com/tich/homebridge-faber-rangehood#configuration) for how to get your refresh token and device IDs.

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: From get_token.py. The plugin keeps it up to date by itself, so it's only needed once, unless the log says it has expired or is invalid (e.g. after changing your Faber account's password)

fallback_poll_interval.title: Fallback Poll Interval (seconds)
fallback_poll_interval.description: The hoods' status is pushed to Homebridge as it changes. As a safety net, it's also polled this often. When push updates aren't available, it's polled every few seconds instead

devices.title: Range Hoods
devices.description: The range hoods to show in the Home app. get_token.py lists the ones in your Faber account

name.title: Device Name (Optional)
name.description: Changing it renames the device and its light, fan, and filters in the Home app, replacing any names set there
